content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 denial for missing prior auth; this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer, and an appeal with medical necessity has already been filed without success. There is no remaining avenue to obtain payment, and under Medicare Advantage rules the patient cannot be balance-billed for the provider's failure to secure required authorization. Resubmitting would only draw a duplicate denial and waste touches.","action":"write_off"}
